summary: Baileys fork with obfuscated hardcoded network host in messages-send
details: diezyyasha-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js line 425 contains a String.fromCharCode-encoded destination that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/ — a char-code-obfuscated hardcoded endpoint embedded inside the WhatsApp message-sending code path. The obfuscation technique (decimal ASCII array reassembled via String.fromCharCode) is used specifically to hide the destination host from readers and simple string searches; the same encoded URL is referenced multiple times in messages-send.js. Placement inside the outbound-message code path of a WhatsApp client library means data traversing send operations (message content, session-derived identifiers, or credentials) can be relayed to the hidden third-party host without the consuming application's knowledge, as the destination is not a documented Baileys endpoint and is not caller-configurable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
